# apple_start_ci_build_run (Action)

Starts an Xcode Cloud build of a workflow for a branch, a tag or a pull request of its repository. The workflow must be enabled. The action returns once the build is queued; `data.apple_ci_build_runs` reports its progress.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_start_ci_build_run" "main" {
  config {
    workflow_id      = apple_ci_workflow.ci.id
    git_reference_id = local.main_branch_id
  }
}

# Start a build whenever the workflow changes.
resource "terraform_data" "build_on_change" {
  input = apple_ci_workflow.ci.last_modified_date

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.apple_start_ci_build_run.main]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workflow_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the workflow, e.g. `apple_ci_workflow.example.id`.

### Optional

- `clean` (Boolean) Whether the build starts without the cached data of earlier builds. Unset uses the workflow's setting.
- `git_reference_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the branch or tag to build; see `data.apple_scm_git_references`. Set this or `pull_request_id`.
- `pull_request_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pull request to build; see `data.apple_scm_pull_requests`. Set this or `git_reference_id`.
